adaptive-decay.HelpText: adaptive-p: decay rate for target adaptation over time. lower values are more reactive, higher values are more stable. (valid range 0.0 to 0.99) (default: 0.90)

adaptive-target.HelpText: adaptive-p: select tokens near this probability (valid range 0.0 to 1.0; negative = disabled) (default: -1.00) [(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/17927)

agent.HelpText: whether to enable CORS proxy and all built-in tools - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled) note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

alias.HelpText: set model name aliases, comma-separated (to be used by API)

api-key.HelpText: API key to use for authentication, multiple keys can be provided as a comma-separated list (default: none)

api-key-file.HelpText: path to file containing API keys, one per line; lines starting with a hash are treated as comments (default: none)

api-prefix.HelpText: prefix path the server serves from, without the trailing slash (default: )

cache-idle-slots.HelpText: save idle slots to the prompt cache on new task, and clear them when using unified KV (default: enabled, requires cache-ram)

cache-list.HelpText: show list of models in cache

cache-prompt.HelpText: whether to enable prompt caching (default: enabled)

cache-ram.HelpText: set the maximum cache size in MiB (default: 8192, -1 - no limit, 0 - disable)[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/16391)

cache-reuse.HelpText: min chunk size to attempt reusing from the cache via KV shifting, requires prompt caching to be enabled (default: 0) [(card)](https://ggml.ai/f0.png)

cache-type-k.HelpText: KV cache data type for K (default: f16)

cache-type-k-draft.HelpText: KV cache data type for K for the draft model (default: f16)

cache-type-v.HelpText: KV cache data type for V (default: f16)

cache-type-v-draft.HelpText: KV cache data type for V for the draft model (default: f16)

chat-template.HelpText: set custom jinja chat template (default: template taken from model's metadata) if suffix/prefix are specified, template will be disabled only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set before this flag): list of built-in templates: bailing, bailing-think, bailing2, chatglm3, chatglm4, chatml, command-r, deepseek, deepseek-ocr, deepseek2, deepseek3, exaone-moe, exaone3, exaone4, falcon3, gemma, gigachat, glmedge, gpt-oss, granite, granite-4.0, granite-4.1, grok-2, hunyuan-dense, hunyuan-moe, hunyuan-vl, kimi-k2, llama2, llama2-sys, llama2-sys-bos, llama2-sys-strip, llama3, llama4, megrez, minicpm, mistral-v1, mistral-v3, mistral-v3-tekken, mistral-v7, mistral-v7-tekken, monarch, openchat, orion, pangu-embedded, phi3, phi4, rwkv-world, seed_oss, smolvlm, solar-open, vicuna, vicuna-orca, yandex, zephyr

chat-template-file.HelpText: set custom jinja chat template file (default: template taken from model's metadata) if suffix/prefix are specified, template will be disabled only commonly used templates are accepted (unless --jinja is set before this flag): list of built-in templates: bailing, bailing-think, bailing2, chatglm3, chatglm4, chatml, command-r, deepseek, deepseek-ocr, deepseek2, deepseek3, exaone-moe, exaone3, exaone4, falcon3, gemma, gigachat, glmedge, gpt-oss, granite, granite-4.0, granite-4.1, grok-2, hunyuan-dense, hunyuan-moe, hunyuan-vl, kimi-k2, llama2, llama2-sys, llama2-sys-bos, llama2-sys-strip, llama3, llama4, megrez, minicpm, mistral-v1, mistral-v3, mistral-v3-tekken, mistral-v7, mistral-v7-tekken, monarch, openchat, orion, pangu-embedded, phi3, phi4, rwkv-world, seed_oss, smolvlm, solar-open, vicuna, vicuna-orca, yandex, zephyr

chat-template-kwargs.HelpText: sets additional params for the json template parser, must be a valid json object string, e.g. '{"key1":"value1","key2":"value2"}'

check-tensors.HelpText: check model tensor data for invalid values (default: false)

checkpoint-min-step.HelpText: minimum spacing between context checkpoints in tokens (default: 8192, 0 = no minimum)

completion-bash.HelpText: print source-able bash completion script for llama.cpp

cont-batching.HelpText: whether to enable continuous batching (a.k.a dynamic batching) (default: enabled)

context-shift.HelpText: whether to use context shift on infinite text generation (default: disabled)

control-vector.HelpText: add a control vector note: use comma-separated values to add multiple control vectors

control-vector-layer-range.HelpText: layer range to apply the control vector(s) to, start and end inclusive

control-vector-scaled.HelpText: add a control vector with user defined scaling SCALE note: use comma-separated values (format: FNAME:SCALE,...)

cors-credentials.HelpText: whether to allow credentials for CORS (default: enabled) note: if this is enabled and --cors-origins is set to * (default), the Origin header will be echoed back, and credentials will always be allowed

cors-headers.HelpText: comma-separated list of allowed headers for CORS (default: *)

cors-methods.HelpText: comma-separated list of allowed methods for CORS (default: GET, POST, DELETE, OPTIONS)

cors-origins.HelpText: comma-separated list of allowed origins for CORS (default: *) if set to special value 'localhost', reflect the Origin header only if it is localhost

cpu-mask.HelpText: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range (default: "")

cpu-mask-batch.HelpText: CPU affinity mask: arbitrarily long hex. Complements cpu-range-batch (default: same as --cpu-mask)

cpu-mask-batch-draft.HelpText: Draft model CPU affinity mask. Complements cpu-range-draft (default: same as --cpu-mask)

cpu-mask-draft.HelpText: Draft model CPU affinity mask. Complements cpu-range-draft (default: same as --cpu-mask)

cpu-moe.HelpText: keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU

cpu-moe-draft.HelpText: keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU for the draft model

cpu-range.HelpText: range of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask

cpu-range-batch.HelpText: ranges of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask-batch

cpu-range-draft.HelpText: Ranges of CPUs for affinity. Complements --cpu-mask-draft

cpu-strict-batch.HelpText: use strict CPU placement (default: same as --cpu-strict)

cpu-strict-batch-draft.HelpText: Use strict CPU placement for draft model (default: --cpu-strict-draft)

cpu-strict-draft.HelpText: Use strict CPU placement for draft model (default: same as --cpu-strict)

ctx-size.HelpText: size of the prompt context (default: 0, 0 = loaded from model)

device.HelpText: comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading (none = don't offload) use --list-devices to see a list of available devices

device-draft.HelpText: comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading the draft model (none = don't offload) use --list-devices to see a list of available devices

direct-io.HelpText: DEPRECATED in favor of `--load-mode`: use DirectIO if available

docker-repo.HelpText: Docker Hub model repository. repo is optional, default to ai/. quant is optional, default to :latest. example: gemma3 (default: unused)

draft-max.HelpText: the argument has been removed. use --spec-draft-n-max or --spec-ngram-mod-n-max

draft-n-min.HelpText: the argument has been removed. use --spec-draft-n-min or --spec-ngram-mod-n-min

dry-allowed-length.HelpText: set allowed length for DRY sampling (default: 2)

dry-penalty-last-n.HelpText: set DRY penalty for the last n tokens (default: -1, 0 = disable, -1 = context size)

dry-sequence-breaker.HelpText: add sequence breaker for DRY sampling, clearing out default breakers ('\n', ':', '"', '*') in the process; use "none" to not use any sequence breakers

embd-gemma-default.HelpText: use default EmbeddingGemma model (note: can download weights from the internet)

embeddings.HelpText: restrict to only support embedding use case; use only with dedicated embedding models (default: disabled)

escape.HelpText: whether to process escapes sequences (\n, \r, \t, \', \", \\) (default: true)

fim-qwen-1.5b-default.HelpText: use default Qwen 2.5 Coder 1.5B (note: can download weights from the internet)

fim-qwen-14b-spec.HelpText: use Qwen 2.5 Coder 14B + 0.5B draft for speculative decoding (note: can download weights from the internet)

fim-qwen-30b-default.HelpText: use default Qwen 3 Coder 30B A3B Instruct (note: can download weights from the internet)

fim-qwen-3b-default.HelpText: use default Qwen 2.5 Coder 3B (note: can download weights from the internet)

fim-qwen-7b-default.HelpText: use default Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B (note: can download weights from the internet)

fim-qwen-7b-spec.HelpText: use Qwen 2.5 Coder 7B + 0.5B draft for speculative decoding (note: can download weights from the internet)

fit.HelpText: whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off', default: 'on')

fit-ctx.HelpText: minimum ctx size that can be set by --fit option, default: 4096

fit-target.HelpText: target margin per device for --fit, comma-separated list of values, single value is broadcast across all devices, default: 1024

flash-attn.HelpText: set Flash Attention use ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto')

gpt-oss-120b-default.HelpText: use gpt-oss-120b (note: can download weights from the internet)

gpt-oss-20b-default.HelpText: use gpt-oss-20b (note: can download weights from the internet)

grammar.HelpText: BNF-like grammar to constrain generations (see samples in grammars/ dir)

hf-file.HelpText: Hugging Face model file. If specified, it will override the quant in --hf-repo (default: unused)

hf-file-v.HelpText: Hugging Face model file for the vocoder model (default: unused)

hf-repo.HelpText: Hugging Face model repository; quant is optional, case-insensitive, default to Q4_K_M, or falls back to the first file in the repo if Q4_K_M doesn't exist. mmproj is also downloaded automatically if available. to disable, add --no-mmproj example: ggml-org/GLM-4.7-Flash-GGUF:Q4_K_M (default: unused)

hf-repo-draft.HelpText: Same as --hf-repo, but for the draft model (default: unused)

hf-repo-v.HelpText: Hugging Face model repository for the vocoder model (default: unused)

hf-token.HelpText: Hugging Face access token (default: value from HF_TOKEN environment variable)

host.HelpText: ip address to listen, or bind to an UNIX socket if the address ends with .sock (default: 127.0.0.1)

ignore-eos.HelpText: ignore end of stream token and continue generating (implies --logit-bias EOS-inf)

image-max-tokens.HelpText: maximum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution (default: read from model)

image-min-tokens.HelpText: minimum number of tokens each image can take, only used by vision models with dynamic resolution (default: read from model)

jinja.HelpText: whether to use jinja template engine for chat (default: enabled)

json-schema.HelpText: JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{}` for any JSON object For schemas w/ external $refs, use --grammar + example/json_schema_to_grammar.py instead

json-schema-file.HelpText: File containing a JSON schema to constrain generations (https://json-schema.org/), e.g. `{}` for any JSON object For schemas w/ external $refs, use --grammar + example/json_schema_to_grammar.py instead

keep.HelpText: number of tokens to keep from the initial prompt (default: 0, -1 = all)

kv-offload.HelpText: whether to enable KV cache offloading (default: enabled)

kv-unified.Default: enabled if number of slots is auto
kv-unified.HelpText: use single unified KV buffer shared across all sequences (default: enabled if number of slots is auto)

list-devices.HelpText: print list of available devices and exit

load-mode.HelpText: model loading mode (default: mmap) - none: no special loading mode - mmap: memory-map model (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock) - mlock: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - mmap+mlock: mmap + force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - dio: use DirectIO if available

log-colors.HelpText: Set colored logging ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto') 'auto' enables colors when output is to a terminal

log-prompts-dir.HelpText: Log prompts to directory (auto-created if not present; only used for debugging, default: disabled)

log-verbose.HelpText: Set verbosity level to infinity (i.e. log all messages, useful for debugging)

log-verbosity.HelpText: Set the verbosity threshold. Messages with a higher verbosity will be ignored. Values: - 0: generic output - 1: error - 2: warning - 3: info - 4: trace (more info) - 5: debug (default: 3)

logit-bias.HelpText: modifies the likelihood of token appearing in the completion, i.e. `--logit-bias 15043+1` to increase likelihood of token ' Hello', or `--logit-bias 15043-1` to decrease likelihood of token ' Hello'

lookup-cache-dynamic.HelpText: path to dynamic lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (updated by generation)

lookup-cache-static.HelpText: path to static lookup cache to use for lookup decoding (not updated by generation)

lora.HelpText: path to LoRA adapter (use comma-separated values to load multiple adapters)

lora-init-without-apply.HelpText: load LoRA adapters without applying them (apply later via POST /lora-adapters) (default: disabled)

lora-scaled.HelpText: path to LoRA adapter with user defined scaling (format: FNAME:SCALE,...) note: use comma-separated values

main-gpu.HelpText: the GPU to use for the model (with split-mode = none), or for intermediate results and KV (with split-mode = row) (default: 0)

mcp-servers-config.HelpText: experimental: path to JSON file with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none) note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

mcp-servers-json.HelpText: experimental: inline JSON with MCP server definitions (Cursor-compatible format) - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: none) note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

media-path.HelpText: directory for loading local media files; files can be accessed via file:// URLs using relative paths (default: disabled)

metrics.HelpText: enable prometheus compatible metrics endpoint (default: disabled)

mirostat.HelpText: use Mirostat sampling. Top K, Nucleus and Locally Typical samplers are ignored if used. (default: 0, 0 = disabled, 1 = Mirostat, 2 = Mirostat 2.0)

mlock.HelpText: DEPRECATED in favor of `--load-mode`: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing

mmap.HelpText: DEPRECATED in favor of `--load-mode`: whether to memory-map model. (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock)

mmproj.HelpText: path to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md note: if -hf is used, this argument can be omitted

mmproj-auto.HelpText: whether to use multimodal projector file (if available), useful when using -hf (default: enabled)

mmproj-offload.HelpText: whether to enable GPU offloading for multimodal projector (default: enabled)

mmproj-url.HelpText: URL to a multimodal projector file. see tools/mtmd/README.md

model-draft.HelpText: draft model for speculative decoding (default: unused)

model-vocoder.HelpText: vocoder model for audio generation (default: unused)

models-autoload.HelpText: for router server, whether to automatically load models (default: enabled)

models-dir.HelpText: directory containing models for the router server (default: disabled)

models-max.HelpText: for router server, maximum number of models to load simultaneously (default: 4, 0 = unlimited)

models-preset.HelpText: path to INI file containing model presets for the router server (default: disabled)

mtmd-batch-max-tokens.HelpText: maximum number of image tokens per batch when encoding images (default: 1024)

n-cpu-moe.HelpText: keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU

n-cpu-moe-draft.HelpText: keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU for the draft model

n-gpu-layers.HelpText: max. number of layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all' (default: auto)

n-gpu-layers-draft.HelpText: max. number of draft model layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all' (default: auto)

n-predict.HelpText: number of tokens to predict (default: -1, -1 = infinity)

no-host.HelpText: bypass host buffer allowing extra buffers to be used

numa.HelpText: attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems - distribute: spread execution evenly over all nodes - isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution started on - numactl: use the CPU map provided by numactl if run without this previously, it is recommended to drop the system page cache before using this see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/1437

offline.HelpText: Offline mode: forces use of cache, prevents network access

op-offload.HelpText: whether to offload host tensor operations to device (default: true)

override-kv.HelpText: advanced option to override model metadata by key. to specify multiple overrides, either use comma-separated values. types: int, float, bool, str. example: --override-kv tokenizer.ggml.add_bos_token=bool:false,tokenizer.ggml.add_eos_token=bool:false

override-tensor-draft.HelpText: override tensor buffer type for draft model

path.HelpText: path to serve static files from (default: )

perf.HelpText: whether to enable internal libllama performance timings (default: false)

poll.HelpText: use polling level to wait for work (0 - no polling, default: 50)

poll-batch.HelpText: use polling to wait for work (default: same as --poll)

poll-batch-draft.HelpText: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: --poll-draft)

poll-draft.HelpText: Use polling to wait for draft model work (default: same as --poll)

pooling.HelpText: pooling type for embeddings, use model default if unspecified

prefill-assistant.HelpText: whether to prefill the assistant's response if the last message is an assistant message (default: prefill enabled) when this flag is set, if the last message is an assistant message then it will be treated as a full message and not prefilled

prio.HelpText: set process/thread priority : low(-1), normal(0), medium(1), high(2), realtime(3) (default: 0)

props.HelpText: enable changing global properties via POST /props (default: disabled)

reasoning.HelpText: Use reasoning/thinking in the chat ('on', 'off', or 'auto', default: 'auto' (detect from template))

reasoning-budget.HelpText: token budget for thinking: -1 for unrestricted, 0 for immediate end, N>0 for token budget (default: -1)

reasoning-budget-message.HelpText: message injected before the end-of-thinking tag when reasoning budget is exhausted (default: none)

reasoning-format.HelpText: controls whether thought tags are allowed and/or extracted from the response, and in which format they're returned; one of: - none: leaves thoughts unparsed in `message.content` - deepseek: puts thoughts in `message.reasoning_content` - deepseek-legacy: keeps `<think>` tags in `message.content` while also populating `message.reasoning_content` (default: auto)

reasoning-preserve.HelpText: preserve reasoning trace in the full history, not just the last assistant message (default: template default) compatible with certain templates having 'supports_preserve_reasoning' capability example: https://docs.z.ai/guides/capabilities/thinking-mode#preserved-thinking

repack.HelpText: whether to enable weight repacking (default: enabled)

repeat-last-n.HelpText: last n tokens to consider for penalize (default: 64, 0 = disabled, -1 = ctx_size)

repeat-penalty.HelpText: penalize repeat sequence of tokens (default: 1.00, 1.0 = disabled)

reranking.HelpText: enable reranking endpoint on server (default: disabled)

reuse-port.HelpText: allow multiple sockets to bind to the same port (default: disabled)

reverse-prompt.HelpText: halt generation at PROMPT, return control in interactive mode

rope-freq-base.HelpText: RoPE base frequency, used by NTK-aware scaling (default: loaded from model)

rope-freq-scale.HelpText: RoPE frequency scaling factor, expands context by a factor of 1/N

rope-scale.HelpText: RoPE context scaling factor, expands context by a factor of N

rope-scaling.HelpText: RoPE frequency scaling method, defaults to linear unless specified by the model

samplers.HelpText: samplers that will be used for generation in the order, separated by ';' (default: penalties;dry;top_n_sigma;top_k;typ_p;top_p;min_p;xtc;temperature)

sampling-seq.HelpText: simplified sequence for samplers that will be used (default: edskypmxt)

seed.HelpText: RNG seed (default: -1, use random seed for -1)

skip-chat-parsing.HelpText: force a pure content parser, even if a Jinja template is specified; model will output everything in the content section, including any reasoning and/or tool calls (default: disabled)

sleep-idle-seconds.HelpText: number of seconds of idleness after which the server will sleep (default: -1; -1 = disabled)

slot-prompt-similarity.HelpText: how much the prompt of a request must match the prompt of a slot in order to use that slot (default: 0.10, 0.0 = disabled)

slot-save-path.HelpText: path to save slot kv cache (default: disabled)

spec-draft-backend-sampling.HelpText: offload draft sampling to the backend (default: enabled)

spec-draft-n-max.HelpText: number of tokens to draft for speculative decoding (default: 3)

spec-draft-n-min.HelpText: minimum number of draft tokens to use for speculative decoding (default: 0)

spec-ngram-map-k-min-hits.HelpText: minimum hits for ngram-map-k speculative decoding (default: 1)

spec-ngram-map-k-size-m.HelpText: ngram size M for ngram-map-k speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram (default: 48)

spec-ngram-map-k-size-n.HelpText: ngram size N for ngram-map-k speculative decoding, length of lookup n-gram (default: 12)

spec-ngram-map-k4v-min-hits.HelpText: minimum hits for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding (default: 1)

spec-ngram-map-k4v-size-m.HelpText: ngram size M for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram (default: 48)

spec-ngram-map-k4v-size-n.HelpText: ngram size N for ngram-map-k4v speculative decoding, length of lookup n-gram (default: 12)

spec-ngram-min-hits.HelpText: the argument has been removed. use the respective --spec-ngram-*-min-hits

spec-ngram-mod-n-max.HelpText: maximum number of ngram tokens to use for ngram-based speculative decoding (default: 64)

spec-ngram-mod-n-min.HelpText: minimum number of ngram tokens to use for ngram-based speculative decoding (default: 48)

spec-ngram-simple-min-hits.HelpText: minimum hits for ngram-simple speculative decoding (default: 1)

spec-ngram-simple-size-m.HelpText: ngram size M for ngram-simple speculative decoding, length of draft m-gram (default: 48)

spec-ngram-simple-size-n.HelpText: ngram size N for ngram-simple speculative decoding, length of lookup n-gram (default: 12)

spec-ngram-size-m.HelpText: the argument has been removed. use the respective --spec-ngram-*-size-m

spec-ngram-size-n.HelpText: the argument has been removed. use the respective --spec-ngram-*-size-n or --spec-ngram-mod-n-match

spec-type.HelpText: comma-separated list of types of speculative decoding to use (default: none)

split-mode.HelpText: how to split the model across multiple GPUs, one of: - none: use one GPU only - layer (default): split layers and KV across GPUs (pipelined) - row: split weight across GPUs by rows (parallelized) - tensor: split weights and KV across GPUs (parallelized, EXPERIMENTAL)

spm-infill.HelpText: use Suffix/Prefix/Middle pattern for infill (instead of Prefix/Suffix/Middle) as some models prefer this. (default: disabled)

sse-ping-interval.HelpText: server SSE ping interval in seconds (-1 = disabled, default: 30)

ssl-cert-file.HelpText: path to file a PEM-encoded SSL certificate

ssl-key-file.HelpText: path to file a PEM-encoded SSL private key

swa-checkpoints.HelpText: max number of context checkpoints to create per slot (default: 32)[(more info)](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/pull/15293)

tags.HelpText: set model tags, comma-separated (informational, not used for routing)

tensor-split.HelpText: fraction of the model to offload to each GPU, comma-separated list of proportions, e.g. 3,1

threads.HelpText: number of CPU threads to use during generation (default: -1)

threads-batch.HelpText: number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads)

threads-batch-draft.HelpText: number of threads to use during batch and prompt processing (default: same as --threads-draft)

threads-draft.HelpText: number of threads to use during generation (default: same as --threads)

threads-http.HelpText: number of threads used to process HTTP requests (default: -1)

tools.HelpText: experimental: whether to enable built-in tools for AI agents - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: no tools) specify "all" to enable all tools available tools: read_file, file_glob_search, grep_search, exec_shell_command, write_file, edit_file, get_datetime note: for security reasons, this will limit --cors-origins to localhost by default

tts-use-guide-tokens.HelpText: Use guide tokens to improve TTS word recall

typical-p.HelpText: locally typical sampling, parameter p (default: 1.00, 1.0 = disabled)

ui.HelpText: whether to enable the Web UI (default: enabled)

ui-mcp-proxy.HelpText: experimental: whether to enable MCP CORS proxy - do not enable in untrusted environments (default: disabled)

vision-gemma-12b-default.HelpText: use Gemma 3 12B QAT (note: can download weights from the internet)

vision-gemma-4b-default.HelpText: use Gemma 3 4B QAT (note: can download weights from the internet)

warmup.HelpText: whether to perform warmup with an empty run (default: enabled)

webui-config.HelpText: JSON that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

webui-config-file.HelpText: JSON file that provides default UI settings (overrides UI defaults)

yarn-attn-factor.HelpText: YaRN: scale sqrt(t) or attention magnitude (default: -1.00)

yarn-beta-fast.HelpText: YaRN: low correction dim or beta (default: -1.00)

yarn-beta-slow.HelpText: YaRN: high correction dim or alpha (default: -1.00)

yarn-ext-factor.HelpText: YaRN: extrapolation mix factor (default: -1.00, 0.0 = full interpolation)

yarn-orig-ctx.HelpText: YaRN: original context size of model (default: 0 = model training context size)
